crossRefs.note: I have waited for your salvation, Yahweh.
Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who…
I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.
But as for me, I will look to Yahweh. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes…
But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.
May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love, and into the perseverance of Christ.
Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.
Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.
Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.
not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as…
But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.
He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I come quickly.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus.

translations.web: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
translations.bsb: You, too, be patient and strengthen your hearts, because the Lord’s coming is near.
translations.kjv: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.
translations.asv: Be ye also patient; establish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
